text:
mona: Heads up — console shows per-model cost for 'm-embed-8q' spiking since we changed routing yesterday. Token burn looks normal but the cache savings panel dropped ~30%. Anyone else seeing a gap?

sam: saw that too. my first guess is that prefetch credits weren't attributed after the router started short-circuiting to hotpath instances.

ria: quick check — telemetry shows prefetch_hit events still emitted, but the cost-aggregator query returns much lower prefetch_hit_count for affected routes.

luis: I pulled a raw sample and noticed route_id was null in ~6% of the prefetch events during the rollout window. could be our router proxy dropping route tag on fallback. :thinking_face:

mona: that would explain it — dashboard apportions shared cache savings by route using the prefetch_hit_count key. if route_id is missing we drop the credit into an "unattributed" bucket which we then amortize away.

sam: two paths: (A) fix router to always attach route metadata on prefetch events; (B) change attribution to fall back to model_variant or tenant when route_id is missing. prefer quick fallback so reporting recovers.

ria: agree. quick fallback: allocate unattributed prefetch credits proportional to each route's prefetch_hits+tokens in the same time window. rough algorithm: apportioned_share(route) = (route_prefetch_hits * route_token_weight) / sum_over_routes(...).

luis: pseudocode I ran locally:
```
-- fallback apportioner
WITH window AS (
  SELECT route_id, sum(prefetch_hits) AS hits, sum(tokens) AS toks
  FROM raw_events
  WHERE ts BETWEEN $start AND $end
  GROUP BY route_id
), totals AS (
  SELECT sum(hits) AS total_hits, sum(toks) AS total_toks FROM window
)
SELECT w.route_id, ((w.hits + 0.1 * w.toks) / (totals.total_hits + 0.1 * totals.total_toks)) AS share
FROM window w, totals;
```
This gives stable splits even for near-zero hit routes.

mona: nice. UX question: should the Console show the original raw "unattributed" bucket and also the apportioned view? Product asked for transparency.

sam: show both. label explicitly: "apportioned prefetch credits (fallback applied)" and have a toggle to reveal raw unattributed bucket. keep audit trail. :thumbsup:

ria: ops concern — changing attribution formula will change customers' per-route unit economics. we need a rollout plan and a clear note in billing preview. I propose feature-flagged rollout + 7-day canary for 3 enterprise orgs.

luis: +1. Also add a telemetry flag to the prefetch event envelope so downstream aggregators can detect whether route_id was original or inferred. simple boolean: `route_inferred:true|false`. minimal schema bump.

mona: API/telemetry change: add optional boolean `route_inferred` and string `fallback_basis` (values: "tenant", "model_variant", "apportioner"). That will help audits later. small PR incoming.

sam: for the Console: add an inline hover explanation for apportioned numbers and a link to a runbook. I'll take the frontend task.

dev-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://internal/tasks/RED-2345 — tests: aggregator unit, apportioner integration, console toggle, billing-preview note.

mona: rollout plan sketch: 1) fix router bug for route_id propagation (patch, canary), 2) ship apportioner fallback behind FF, 3) enable FF for 3 orgs + run 7d comparison (apportioned vs raw), 4) enable globally and add billing-preview note.

ria: I'll own the canary monitoring. will add alerts if per-tenant effective cost delta > 5% and user-facing SLA regressions.

luis: I'll PR the telemetry envelope and add migration note. keeping the schema additive so older aggregators ignore new fields.

mona: thanks all. action items: luis PR telemetry, sam frontend toggle + hover, ria create canary alerts, sam + luis coordinate FF gating, mona will draft billing-preview copy. ping me in this thread when PRs link. :rocket:
